description: This file defines functions for expanding recurring calendar events within a specified date range and scheduling reminders for events, utilizing models and a notification client. It is part of an API service layer in a calendar application.

classes.name: EventModel
classes.description: Data model representing a calendar event, including properties like start_time, end_time, recurrence, and reminders.

methods.name: List[EventModel] expand_event_recurrence(event: EventModel, range_start: datetime, range_end: datetime)
methods.description: Expands a recurring event into individual event instances within a specified date range, handling daily and weekly frequencies.

methods.name: schedule_event_reminders(event: EventModel, notification_client: NotificationClient)
methods.description: Schedules reminders for an event by calculating times before the event start and invoking an external notification client.

ctags.pattern: /^def expand_event_recurrence(event: EventModel, range_start: datetime, range_end: datetime) -> Li/
